question.text: A Cat III AIF's assets include:

answer.text: Cash, securities, dividends/interest receivable, provisional expenses, and all other assets

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, assets include cash/bank, all securities, dividends receivable, interest, financial rights from derivatives, provisional expenses, and all other assets. The Trap: Narrow lists miss categories of valid assets. Cross-Exam Context: Comprehensive asset definition shared with Ind-AS framework. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Map fund's general ledger against this checklist to prevent valuation-base omissions.
